title: SimMIM: A Simple Framework for Masked Image Modeling
why_relevant: Provides a simple, high-performing masked image modeling recipe that can be used to pretrain an encoder on unlabeled Sentinel-2 patches before fine-tuning on the small labeled set.
extracted_technique: Masked image modeling with random masking and lightweight prediction head; use pretrained-capable transformer backbones; pretrain then fine-tune for classification.
query: SimMIM masked image modeling paper arXiv 2021
takeaway: SimMIM is an implementation-friendly masked pretraining approach that can improve downstream accuracy under limited labels, aligning well with the competition’s SSL intent.

title: SatMAE: Pre-training Transformers for Temporal and Multi-Spectral Satellite Imagery
why_relevant: Directly targets temporal and multi-spectral satellite imagery, matching the unlabeled time-series Sentinel-2 structure in this competition and motivating a temporal-aware SSL pretrain stage.
extracted_technique: Masked autoencoding adapted to satellite imagery with temporal/multispectral structure; pretrain on unlabeled sequences then fine-tune on labeled downstream tasks.
takeaway: SatMAE suggests that exploiting temporal structure during masked pretraining can improve transfer performance; this informs a higher-capacity pretraining option beyond single-image SSL.

title: Models API and Pretrained weights | timmdocs
why_relevant: Explains how timm loads pretrained weights when the input has non-RGB channel counts, which is essential for 12-band Sentinel-2 models using ImageNet-pretrained backbones.
extracted_technique: Use `timm.create_model(..., pretrained=True, in_chans=k)`; timm adapts first conv weights by summing for 1-channel or repeating/slicing with scaling for k-channel inputs.
takeaway: timm’s `in_chans` support makes it practical to use strong pretrained backbones for multispectral inputs without manually rewriting model stems.

title: ICPR 2024 Competition on Beyond Visible Spectrum: AI for Agriculture
why_relevant: Provides series-level evidence that leaderboard ranking for similar tasks in this competition family is reported in terms of accuracy, supporting an accuracy-maximization plan when Kaggle’s metric text cannot be fetched.
extracted_technique: Treat the primary evaluation as accuracy; emphasize reproducibility and transfer performance from SSL pretraining to labeled fine-tuning.
query: ICPR 2024 beyond visible spectrum AI for agriculture task 2 accuracy metric
takeaway: Although not definitive for 2026p2, the report strongly suggests accuracy is a central quantitative metric in the series, making it a reasonable default metric assumption.
